scripts.dev: bun run --filter @hudsonkit/ai build && bun run --filter hudsonkit build && bun run --cwd apps/web dev
scripts.build: bun run --filter @hudsonkit/ai build && bun run --filter @hudsonkit/admin build && bun run --filter hudsonkit build && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.build:site: bun run build && bun run --cwd apps/web embed:bundle && bun run --cwd apps/web export-pages
scripts.deploy:hudsonkit: bun run build:site && bun run --cwd apps/web cf:deploy
scripts.upload:hudsonkit: bun run build:site && bun run --cwd apps/web cf:upload
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/web/admin typecheck
scripts.test: bun run test:ci-classifier && bun run --cwd apps/web test
scripts.dev:studio: bun run --filter hudsonkit build && bun --cwd apps/studio dev
